title: 近10家国际公司：排队来港上市，港交所如何承接？
speaker: Bonnie Chan

segments.en: A lot of the companies, especially in the Asian region, they, because of, you know, the constant need for accessing the capital markets to support their growth, they quite like the fact that they can access Hong Kong, which has obviously a deeper liquidity pool.
segments.zh: 许多公司，尤其是亚洲地区的公司，由于持续需要进入资本市场来支持增长，他们非常喜欢香港，因为香港拥有更深的流动性池。

segments.en: And so, you know, for companies which might have outgrown their domestic market, having another listing in Hong Kong is very, very attractive.
segments.zh: 因此，对于那些已经超越本土市场的公司来说，在香港上市非常有吸引力。

segments.en: Now, in our pipeline, we actually have close to 10 companies, which are what we call international companies.
segments.zh: 目前，我们的上市管道中大约有10家国际公司。

segments.en: And they are applying for a listing in Hong Kong from various regions, not only Asia and Central Asia.
segments.zh: 他们来自不同地区，不仅限于亚洲和中亚。

segments.en: I also want to emphasize the fact that we are forging a lot of collaboration with regional exchanges.
segments.zh: 我还想强调，我们正在与区域交易所建立大量合作。

segments.en: As you know, I have recently been to Malaysia.
segments.zh: 如你所知，我最近去了马来西亚。

segments.en: With personal Malaysia, we signed an MOU with them in March this year.
segments.zh: 我们与马来西亚交易所今年三月签署了合作备忘录。

segments.en: And we recently recognized them as a recognized stock exchange, therefore making companies listed on personal Malaysia easier to come to Hong Kong for a secondary listing.
segments.zh: 我们最近认可他们为认可交易所，这使得在马来西亚上市的公司更容易来香港进行二次上市。

segments.en: And this follows a very long string of other activities that have been pursuing.
segments.zh: 这延续了我们一直在进行的其他一系列活动。

segments.en: But I do think that you should expect to hear more about our progress, you know, in terms of attracting non-Chinese companies to list on other things.
segments.zh: 但我认为你会听到更多关于我们吸引非中国公司上市进展的消息。

segments.en: It sounds like a lot of focus is on Asia.
segments.zh: 听起来很多焦点都在亚洲。

segments.en: Are you also targeting other regions, like the Middle East or other parts of the world?
segments.zh: 你们是否也瞄准其他地区，比如中东或世界其他地区？

segments.en: But, you know, the reason that you hear me talk more about Asia is frankly because of the point I refer to earlier, which is the fact that it seems to make me that international investors on the whole are getting more focused on Asia.
segments.zh: 但你听到我更多谈论亚洲的原因，坦白说是因为我之前提到的观点，即国际投资者整体上更加关注亚洲。
